additional_info.subject: ID0479593-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P6 170000688] Outlet 1 Overheating CRM:03288000348
additional_info.body:
Dear Kedia,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger we see that the charger was showing errors regarding the cable temp sensor at last on the 18th of february. The last days we have seen no errors in the flags or logs of the charger. The charger looks healthy and stable.
We will keep an eye on the charger for the next three days to see if any error appears.
We need an live error, to be able to send this request to the regional team to perform an on-site check.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0479593-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P6 170000688] Outlet 1 Overheating CRM:03288000348
additional_info.body:
Dear Kedia,
Thank you for your patience regarding your request.
After monitoring the charger, we see that the SCB connection with our system is offline.
This means we are not able to see any updates regarding the charger or error flags.
Please let us know if you are able to turn the SCB connection online again, and let us know when this is the case.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
